newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end lower on U.S. rate fears.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end lower on U.S. rate fears.

text.p: * Main index down by 8.06 points to 3,236.48 points
Philippine shares finished lower on Tuesday with trading mostly in speculative shares, traders said.
"People are waiting for results of the U.S. Fed meeting. There was bullish sentiment on speculative issues and bearish on the fundamentals," Lippo Securities trader Teresa Lee said.
The main index slipped by 8.06 points, or by 0.25 percent, to 3,236.48 points.
The index dropped by 20 points in midsession but recovered some ground in late trade as close to one million shares of Petron Corp shares were bought up by Jardine Fleming Securities, Lee added.
Losers outnumbered gainers 61 to 35 with 79 issues unchanged.
Jonas Ferrer at Pryce Securities said that once the Fed Reserve decides on the interest rates, the local market will slowly detach itself from reliance on external factors.
"Most of our major investors will be focusing themselves on our macro fundamentals," Ferrer predicted.
